title: Worldscale Flat Up!
summary:
edition of the Worldscale Book has revised the flat rates up considerably from previous years as seen below. Carib/USGulf
AG/Sing UKC/USAC AG/LOOP $0.00 The 2005 edition of the Worldscale Book had an assumed bunker price of $173.00 per ton, which was revised upward to $231.50 per ton for the 2006 edition, an increase of 34%. Bunker prices in the Worldscale Book are the average bunker prices for the previous year.
